looks.name: k81-arc
looks._doc: K81's phone look: frozen layout (phy=0&fw=0: both builds settle to one layout), clocks pinned, DOM chrome hidden. Whole frame at 0 moves (base vs head should differ by 0 px), then crops around up to 5 traveled junctions after 10 and 13 cheapest moves (the same boxes on both builds, chosen on the head). Stop short of the finish (?b.J is solved on its 14th move): since K140 a finish throws random confetti, which differs between two shots of one build. A build before K81 lists every junction record; add a needs on fieldProbe.routes to skip it there.
